## Core Services & Hardware Specifications

### 1. LED Screen on Rent & LED Wall Rental (P2, P3 & P4)
- **P2 Ultra-Fine Pitch LED Video Walls**: Ultra-high-density micro-pitch screens engineered for close-proximity viewing (under 2 meters), executive boardroom AGMs, luxury car launches, and broadcast stages requiring pin-sharp font clarity and true 4K/8K presentation visuals.
- **P3 Indoor LED Video Walls**: Ultra-sharp 3840Hz high-refresh rate displays calibrated for corporate keynote decks, financial presentations, and luxury wedding stage backdrops with zero camera flicker and zero scanlines.
- **P4 Outdoor High-Brightness Screens**: Weatherproof, daylight-visible LED screens with 5,000+ nits brightness for open-air concerts, sports screenings, and lawn wedding ceremonies.
- **Video Processors**: NovaStar VX1000 & 4K presentation switchers supporting seamless instant HDMI, Type-C, and wireless presentation switching with zero freeze.

### 2. Audio-Visual & Event Equipment Rental
- **Sound Systems**: Concert-grade line array speaker towers, dual 18-inch subwoofers, and digital mixing consoles.
- **PA Systems & Mics**: Shure and Sennheiser wireless handheld, lapel, and podium gooseneck microphones.
- **Stage & Trussing**: Heavy-duty aluminum box trussing, modular stage platforms, carpeting, safety stairs, and intelligent moving beam lights.
- **Executive Standees**: 55"–75" 4K LED TV displays on chrome floor standees for entrance branding and exhibition booths.

## Key Event Verticals

- **Corporate Summits & AGMs**: Keynote presentations, medical conferences, and corporate townhalls across DLF Cyber City, Udyog Vihar, and Aerocity. Features GST invoicing and rehearsal dry-runs.
- **Weddings & Sangeet**: Royal varmala backdrops, sangeet choreography visual loops, and pre-wedding photo/video reels across Sohna Road and Chattarpur farmhouses.
- **Live Concerts & Festivals**: Large open-air arena LED walls with line-array audio and concert stage lighting.
- **Product Launches**: Flagship curved and flat video wall backdrops with synchronized reveal lighting drops.
